mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient(patient_no, name, gender, birth_date, identity_number, phone, address, emergency_contact, emergency_phone) VALUES(#{patientNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{identityNumber}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone})
mapper.select: SELECT id, admission_no, status, admission_time, discharge_time, department_id, attending_doctor_id FROM admission a WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY admission_time DESC

SELECT a.*, p.patient_no, p.name patient_name, p.gender, p.birth_date, d.name department_name, s.name attending_doctor_name, w.name ward_name, r.room_no, b.bed_no, db.deposit_balance, db.total_charge, db.available_balance FROM admission a JOIN patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id JOIN department d ON d.id=a.department_id JOIN staff s ON s.id=a.attending_doctor_id LEFT JOIN bed b ON b.id=a.current_bed_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id=b.room_id LEFT JOIN ward w ON w.id=r.ward_id LEFT JOIN v_admission_deposit_balance db ON db.admission_id=a.id WHERE a.id=#{id}

SELECT bu.*, w.name ward_name, r.room_no, b.bed_no FROM bed_usage bu JOIN bed b ON b.id=bu.bed_id JOIN room r ON r.id=b.room_id JOIN ward w ON w.id=r.ward_id WHERE bu.admission_id=#{admissionId} ORDER BY bu.start_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE admission SET status='PENDING_DISCHARGE', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{admissionId} AND status='IN_HOSPITAL'
UPDATE admission SET status='CANCELLED', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{admissionId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select:

LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id
w.id=#{wardId} AND b.status=#{status}
ORDER BY d.id, w.id, r.room_no, b.bed_no
